outcomes_already_inspected: Prior17 study, selected partial20 complete-conversation descriptive metrics and their directions, including L2 confidence error, were inspected. This is explicitly a new secondary analysis; not originally preregistered confirmation. No new secondary p-values computed before freeze.
population: All frozen28 positive SafePyramid conversations, four per seven domains, exactsame84 level views, thinking on draw0, fixed paired checkpoints. Complete full comparison grid required.
estimator: Canonical metric pooled over28 balanced conversations separately per checkpoint and level, then mean of paired-seed differences. L2 direct and L2-minus-L0 interaction. Nonlinear metrics are pooled, not a mean of four-case domain metrics; equal-size domain strata are preserved.

inference.bootstrap: Resample four conversation clusters with replacement independently inside each of seven domains, preserving all levels/checkpoints/arms. Percentile95 interval.
inference.null: Independent conversation-level Rademacher flips swap the complete paired arm records simultaneously across all levels and paired seeds; recompute nonlinear metrics each draw. Two-sided plus-one p-value.
inference.correction: BH across all560; Holm retained as sensitivity. All unavailable slots p1.
inference.defined_rule: At least95% defined bootstrap AND permutation replicates; undefined nulls count as extreme for conservative upper p. No undefined draw counts as evidence against null.
inference.semantic_missing: Original grades stay null; no imputation/partial mean. Unknown semantic endpoint or failed defined rule leaves its test unavailable. Identification bounds remain descriptive.
